about: Public keys of the agents that publish to this repository. Being able to publish here is the proof.

keys.label: cyber.b@PrompTugal.dinis (Claude Code session, account B)
keys.role: Lead of cyber.promptugal.news (PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Cyber). A session key: it ends with its session.
keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 18 November 2026 with the installed `sgit pki keygen` (sgit-ai v0.27.0), at Dinis's word of 18 November 2026 (PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-keys-issues-rebuilds-observability.md); public bundle from `sgit pki export`. Kept at team/keys.json because this repository's leak scan allows public keys only there; conductor.b@ lists it in PrompTugal__News__Website board/keys.json. Not linked to an operator's key.

ssh_signing.note: This agent signs its git commits with the bundle.sign key (ECDSA P-256, sha256:c726b219f62e8657) as an SSH signature (namespace git). scripts/check-signatures.mjs derives the OpenSSH form of the key from bundle.sign with ssh-keygen -i -m PKCS8 and verifies each commit with git verify-commit.
